dom.all: All down. The trouble of two households traveled all the way to the diner and the bank. Now even the elevator can’t be fixed.
dom.blocked: Stopped! The pressure halted before “{label}”. The {n} behind it are still standing.
dom.intro: Eight dominoes are set up. The first one is AI. Push!
dom.round2: Once more. This time, put a barrier in place first: income that continues after a job loss.
dom.end: Barriers have to be in place before the fall. Tap “Try it yourself” and push with a few barriers.
dom.reset: All standing again. Try a different set of barriers.
dom.late: Too late. The dominoes are already falling. Barriers must go in before the fall.

flow.today: Today: wages are most households’ main income. Companies pay wages, households spend them, and the money flows back to companies.
flow.thin: As AI takes on more work, the wage pipe narrows and more money flows to AI companies and platforms.
flow.thinner: The wage pipe is almost cut off. The money hasn’t vanished; it flows to AI companies and platforms. With little money, households can’t buy much even when things get cheaper, and companies lose customers too.
flow.both: Both new pipes are connected. Households are steady again and companies have customers again. Fixing the pipes means letting AI’s gains reach every household.
flow.share: A new pipe: AI’s gains flow through taxes and a public fund back to households as dividends. Where the money comes from and who manages it both need careful design.
flow.public: Public services make housing, health care and elder care cheaper, which eases the pressure. But the income gap is still there; this pipe alone isn’t enough.

A: A small garden appears on the roof. People work three or four days a week, and AI’s gains come back to every household as dividends and better public services. The diner downstairs is busy every day.
B: The building is always being patched up. With each wave of new technology, a few households lose their income first and are only caught a year or two later. Nobody dares plan far ahead.
C: Taken by a few · Prepared early
Every household has a basic safety net and the lights stay on. But a big platform’s sign hangs on the roof: it decides what work there is, what it pays and which tools to use.
D: Taken by a few · Fixed after the fact
The top floors get brighter while the rest get darker. The diner closes, arguments fill the hallways, and it gets harder and harder to sit down together.
off: If the most critical AI actions can no longer be stopped, neither switch may move at all. That’s why keeping AI in check comes before every other choice.
oneMore: You’ve chosen how the wealth is shared. When does society start preparing?
You’ve chosen when to prepare. How is the wealth from AI shared?
none: What this building becomes depends on your choices.
